dct_description_sm: Color legend (French and English) shows lines proposed by "the Armistice Commission," "the Ukrainians," and "the Poles for the establishment of a common front with the Rumanian Forces."
Concerns war between Poland and Ukraine over boundary disputes following dissolution of Austria-Hungary.
Handwritten in black ink: "Report presented by...the Inter-Allied Commission for the Negotiation of an Armistice between Poland and the Ukraine (May 15, 1919)."
